purpose: Exercise a deterministic native Conway model through the public Anygine Vulkan, renderer, and UI boundary.

bounded_run.success_marker: BraveNewWorld life-game: validation=requested/enabled errors=0 presented=12 generation=12 live=5 grid=24x24 ui=enabled

acceptance: The pure C++20 model evolves a 24x24 toroidal grid under Conway B3/S23.
Deterministic tests cover blinker, glider, reset, pause/resume, single-step, and boundary wrap.
The public Anygine UI displays generation, live count, controls, and the complete cell grid.
The bounded Vulkan smoke exits after twelve presented frames without user input and reports zero validation errors.
